subject: REMEDIATION_AUTHORITY_BASIS
basis_statement: Evaluation must preserve all validated invariants after creation. No ordinary/public state-restoration or standard serialization reconstruction path may mutate an existing Evaluation or construct a new Evaluation while bypassing complete factory-equivalent validation. The accepted remediation must close generated/public __setstate__, pickle protocol 0/1 reconstruction bypass, mutable restoration alias injection, historical Error eligibility and Stage-ceiling bypass, contributor cardinality/uniqueness/primary-separation bypass, Error-ID prose bypass, strict-bool abstain and confidence/abstain bypass, and caller-controlled skill_signal derivation bypass. Serialization/persistence remains a non-goal. A later governed FIX may either disable unsupported restoration/pickle paths or retain only paths with factory-equivalent validation. Pickle compatibility is not required; prefer the smaller correction. Do not introduce a persistence/serializer framework, hidden authority token, new Evaluation field, parallel Evaluation record, generalized reconstruction framework, shared helper/common/utils abstraction, or other business-scope expansion.
